items.sentence: A tree’s outer covering, which protects the wood from insects and weather, is called its bark.
At midnight, the dog began to bark whenever a stranger stepped onto the porch, alerting the family.
Firefighters rescued the hikers after a storm left them stranded on a narrow ledge with no safe route down.
A sensor in the lab can detect carbon monoxide in the air, triggering an alarm as soon as the gas is present.
The contamination made the drinking water unsafe: tests found cleaning chemicals in a tank that should have contained only fresh water.
To prevent the infection from spreading through the school, nurses isolated the sick students in a separate room until their test results arrived.
Because the footbridge was wet and several boards were loose, Maya was cautious and tested each step before crossing.
Without a scale, the baker estimated the amount of flour by eye and wrote “about two cups” on the recipe card.
